identical_checkpoint_slots: possible and disclosed; duplicate observations are not independent qualification evidence
unreached_epochs: explicit not_reached; no substitution with a more favorable epoch
budget_prevents_terminal_slot: explicit not_captured_budget; no extension or refund

cost_scope: all source checks, checkpoint I/O, no-grad forwards, cold-cache builds, capture and validation charged to C2 process and cumulative active wall
numerical_admission: HOLD until independent audit; recording alone grants no qualification
whole_training_domain: HOLD; this bounded design does not fill the original truncated training trace
